# Write the report

::: {.callout-important}
This real-study section is a scaffold. No real dataset or real findings are bundled yet.
:::

Create `reports/real-study-report.qmd` only after results exist. Include:

1. The real question, citation, accession, population, build and effect units.
2. Source acquisition, importer, exclusions and analysis parameters.
3. Verified allele-specific results, with appropriate uncertainty.
4. Core figures with numerical evidence and study-specific interpretations.
5. Calibration, selection, confounding and causal limitations.
6. Input checksums, software versions and exact commands.

The synthetic template supplies a structure, but every synthetic claim, count and image path must be replaced. The final lesson and worked report will be completed after real-data verification.
